name: GE® 36" 23.6 Cu. Ft. Fingerprint Resistant Stainless Steel Counter Depth Side-By-Side Refrigerator with Extra Tall Dispenser and In-Door Icemaker
shortDescription: GE® 36" 23.6 Cu. Ft. Fingerprint Resistant Stainless Steel Counter Depth Side-By-Side Refrigerator features ab extra tall dispenser that fits 40oz tumblers. The in door ice maker saves on space.

features.text: Extra-Tall Water Dispenser
Easily access filtered water and ice from an extra-tall, 11-inch water dispenser made to fill everyone in the family’s favorite water bottle.
In-Door Icemaker
Located on the freezer door to create more usable shelf storage space. Dispense cubed and crushed ice through the door.
Extra Large Storage Capacity
It's easy to stay organized with extra room to store large or bulk food items with 23.6 cubic feet of storage space.
Extra Large Adjustable Door Bins

Move the clear door bins up and down to fit your storage needs – whether it’s large gallons, tall bottles, or everyday essentials. Two of the fresh food bins are extra large, which means you can fit two gallons of milk plus more, all in just one bin.
Adjustable Fresh Food Shelves
Store more of your favorite tall items like milk cartons and two-liters with three adjustable refrigerator shelves.
Wide Fresh Food Shelves
Take advantage of wide, wall-to-wall glass shelves - perfect for storing party platters, half baking sheets, and more.
Adjustable Freezer Shelves
Organize your way with three adjustable freezer shelves that allow you to store 12-inch frozen pizza boxes flat or standing.
Freezer Storage Drawer
A dedicated freezer drawer helps store bagged frozen items, making it easier to sort, store, and find exactly what you need.
Two Fresh Food Storage Drawers
Two spacious fresh-food drawers give your family plenty of room to store produce, lunch essentials, and all the little extras that keep the week moving.
LED Lighting
Find exactly what you're looking for under crisp, clear, LED lighting.
Advanced Ice and Water Filtration
The included refrigerator water filter reduces 70+ impurities including lead, chlorine, microplastics, and PFOA/PFOS; providing clean, safe drinking water and ice.
Internal Temperature Controls
Moving the temperature controls to the fresh food section gives you a modern exterior.
MultiVent Cooling
Multiple vents distribute air flow to help keep set temperatures consistent.
Door Alarm
Protect your groceries with a door alarm that signals when a door has accidentally been left open.
Magnet-Ready Exterior
Display artwork, school photos, grocery lists, calendars, reminders, and family memories with a magnet-friendly finish designed for real life.
